title: Outstanding Malty Korean Morbier Dosirak
description: A malty, juicy, date-night Korean dish featuring Morbier cheese, served in a dosirak vessel on a comal, with Mediterranean-friendly flavors and an ice-bath-shock technique
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot, then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add the sliced Morbier cheese to the pot and cook for 2 minutes, until it starts to melt.
Remove the cheese from the pot with a slotted spoon and immediately submerge it in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar, Korean chili flakes, and malted milk powder.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked cheese to the skillet, then pour the soy sauce mixture over the top.
Stir everything together, then cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the cheese is fully coated in the sauce.
To serve, place a portion of the cheese mixture onto a comal, then top with chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve the Outstanding Malty Korean Morbier Dosirak in a dosirak vessel and enjoy.
Garnish with additional cilantro and chili flakes, if desired.
